description: Companies with an executive-move announcement in the last 180 days AND a verified funding round in the last 24 months — the wealth advisor's 'money in motion' moment: a new comp package (often equity), an old 401(k) to roll over, benefits about to be re-evaluated. Score-ranked, refreshed daily. For RIAs, wealth managers, retirement-plan advisors, executive-benefits sellers. No API key required.
name: get_money_in_motion
